questions.question: Two taps J and L can fill a tank alone in 10 minutes and 12 minutes respectively. If an outlet tap K is opened and all three taps work together, then the same tank will be filled in 15 minutes. How much time will tap K alone take to empty the same tank?
questions.solution:
Given:

Two taps J and L can fill a tank alone in 10 minutes and 12 minutes respectively.

An outlet tap K is opened and all three taps work together, then the same tank will be filled in 15 minutes.

Concept used:

Efficiency = (Total work / Total time taken)

Efficiency = work done in a single day 

Calculation:

Let total work is 60 units ( LCM of 10,12 and 15) 

The efficiency of J is, 60 /10 = 6 

The efficiency of L is, 60 /12 = 5 

Combined efficiency is, 60 /15 = 4

The efficiency of K is, 6 + 5 - 4 = 7 unit

**So, K alone can empty it in 60 / 7 minutes**

questions.question: A group of boys has an average weight of 42 kg. One boy weighing 48 kg leaves the group and another boy weighing 38 kg joins the group. If the average now becomes 41 kg, then how many boys are there in the group?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net change in total weight = New boy's weight − Old boy's weight = 38 − 48 = −10 kg

Change in average weight = New average − Old average = 41 − 42 = −1 kg

Total number of boys = Net change in total weight ÷ Change in average

⇒ Total boys = −10 ÷ −1 = 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10 boys.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial average weight of a group of boys = 42 kg

Weight of the boy who leaves = 48 kg

Weight of the boy who joins = 38 kg

New average weight of the group = 41 kg

 
 Initial Group: n boys × 42 kg
 
 

 

 Leaves: −48 kg
 
 

 

 Joins: +38 kg
 
 
 Final Group: n boys × 41 kg
 
 Net Change in Total Weight = 38 − 48 = −10 kg

**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of observations ÷ Number of observations

**Calculations:**

Let the number of boys in the group be n.

⇒ Total initial weight of the group = 42 × n = 42n

When one boy weighing 48 kg leaves and another boy weighing 38 kg joins:

⇒ New total weight = 42n − 48 + 38 = 42n − 10

The new average weight of the n boys becomes 41 kg.

⇒ New total weight = 41 × n = 41n

Equating the two expressions for the new total weight:

⇒ 42n − 10 = 41n

⇒ 42n − 41n = 10

⇒ n = 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10 boys.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Net Change in Averages

When an item is replaced, Number of Items = (Value of new item − Value of old item) ÷ (New Average − Old Average).

Weighted Average

If group A has n₁ items with average A₁ and group B has n₂ items with average A₂, then combined average = (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Impact of Addition/Subtraction

If a constant value 'k' is added to or subtracted from all observations, the new average also increases or decreases by 'k'.

questions.question: What is the least number which when divided by 8, 10, 12 and 18 leaves a remainder 5 in each case?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The required number leaves a remainder of 5 when divided by 10.

This means the unit digit of the number must be 5.

Checking the given options, only 365 has a unit digit of 5.

**∴ The correct answer is 365.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Divisors: 8, 10, 12 and 18

Remainder: 5 in each case

**Formula Used:**

Required Least Number = LCM(Divisors) + Remainder

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a4d9b0a57af2cd8b2887d2597011c4f0d51dc79a8e76d40858f298f52bd605ef.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Prime factorization of 8 = 2³

⇒ Prime factorization of 10 = 2 × 5

⇒ Prime factorization of 12 = 2² × 3

⇒ Prime factorization of 18 = 2 × 3²

⇒ LCM = Highest power of each prime factor = 2³ × 3² × 5

⇒ LCM = 8 × 9 × 5 = 360

⇒ Required Number = 360 + 5 = 365

**∴ The correct answer is 365.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM (Least Common Multiple)

The smallest positive integer that is uniformly divisible by all given numbers.

HCF (Highest Common Factor)

The largest positive integer that divides each of the given numbers without leaving a remainder.

Same Remainder Case

If a number when divided by a, b, c leaves the same remainder r, then the Least Number = LCM(a, b, c) + r.

Different Remainders Case

If divided by a, b, c leaves remainders p, q, r such that (a−p) = (b−q) = (c−r) = k, then the Least Number = LCM(a, b, c) − k.

questions.question: The length of a cuboid is half of its breadth and the height of cuboid is thrice of its breadth. If the breadth of the cuboid is 12 cm, then what is the total surface area of cuboid?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given **breadth (b)** = 12 cm.

**Length (l)** = 12 ÷ 2 = 6 cm and **Height (h)** = 12 × 3 = 36 cm.

Ratio of **l : b : h** = 0.5 : 1 : 3 = 1 : 2 : 6.

**Total Surface Area** = 2 × (lb + bh + hl) = 2 × (6×12 + 12×36 + 36×6) = 2 × (72 + 432 + 216) = 2 × 720 = 1440 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 1440 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Breadth (b)** of the cuboid = 12 cm

**Length (l)** = b ÷ 2 = 12 ÷ 2 = 6 cm

**Height (h)** = 3 × b = 3 × 12 = 36 cm

**Formula Used:**

**Total Surface Area (TSA)** of a cuboid = 2(lb + bh + hl)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5fe73fbbef923058d0ccf6d6925835341338a11dc58867ae438992a46c5a046d.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ TSA = 2 × [(6 × 12) + (12 × 36) + (36 × 6)]

⇒ TSA = 2 × [72 + 432 + 216]

⇒ TSA = 2 × [720]

⇒ TSA = 1440 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 1440 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of Cuboid

The amount of space occupied by a 3D cuboid, calculated as **Volume = length × breadth × height (l×b×h)**.

Lateral Surface Area (LSA)

The area of the four vertical faces of the cuboid, excluding the top and bottom, given by **LSA = 2h(l + b)**.

Diagonal of Cuboid

The longest rod that can be placed inside a cuboid, calculated using the formula **Diagonal = √(l² + b² + h²)**.</p

questions.question:
Which of the mathematical signs should be interchanged in the below equation to make it mathematically correct?

14 + 63 ÷ 7 - 21 × 35 = 140
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4671232025562bc3ba9a781319d633acf8cd8e78dc8e96912cd7564a7df4717d.png] 

Option 1) + and -

Given equation is: 14 + 63 ÷ 7 - 21 × 35 = 140

After interchanging the two signs the equation is as follows : 14 - 63 ÷ 7 + 21 × 35 = 140

⇒ 14 - __**63 ÷ 7**__ + 21 × 35 = 140

⇒ 14 - 9 + __**21 × 35**__ = 140

⇒ __**14**__ - 9 __**+ 735**__ = 140

⇒ __**749 - 9**__ = 140

⇒ 740 ≠ 140

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) ÷ and ×

Given equation is: 14 + 63 ÷ 7 - 21 × 35 = 140

After interchanging the two signs the equation is as follows : 14 + 63 × 7 - 21 ÷ 35 = 140

⇒ 14 + 63 × 7 - __**21 ÷ 35**__ = 140

⇒ 14 + __**63 × 7**__ - 0.6 = 140

⇒ __**14 + 441**__ - 0.6 = 140

⇒ __**455**____** - 0.6**__ = 140

⇒ 454.4 ≠ 140

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) - and ×

Given equation is: 14 + 63 ÷ 7 - 21 × 35 = 140

After interchanging the two signs the equation is as follows : 14 + 63 ÷ 7 × 21 - 35 = 140

⇒ 14 + __**63 ÷ 7**__ × 21 - 35 = 140

⇒ 14 + __**9 × 21**__ - 35 = 140

⇒ __**14 + 189**__ - 35 = 140

⇒ __**203 - 35**__ = 140

⇒ 168 ≠ 140

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) + and ×

Given equation is: 14 + 63 ÷ 7 - 21 × 35 = 140

After interchanging the two signs the equation is as follows : 14 × 63 ÷ 7 - 21 + 35 = 140

⇒ 14 × __**63 ÷ 7**__ - 21 + 35 = 140

⇒ __**14 × 9**__ - 21 + 35 = 140

⇒ __**126**__ - 21 __**+ 35**__ = 140

⇒ __**161 - 21**__ = 140

⇒ **140 = 140**

**LHS = RHS**

Hence, the correct answer is **"+ and ×".**

questions.solution:

Logic: (First number ÷ 2) - Second number

First row - 60, 20, 10 → (60 ÷ 2) - 20 = 30 - 20 = 10.

Second row - 90, 30, 15 → (90 ÷ 2) - 30 = 45 - 30 = 15.

Similarly,

**Third row - 36, 12, ? → (36 ÷ 2) - 12 = 18 - 12 = 6.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"6".**

questions.question:
By interchanging the given two signs which of the following equation will be not correct?

+ and ×

I. 15 + 5 ÷ 1 - 9 × 4 = 70

II. 18 × 17 + 3 - 6 ÷ 2 = 133
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4671232025562bc3ba9a781319d633acf8cd8e78dc8e96912cd7564a7df4717d.png] 

I. Given equation : 15 + 5 ÷ 1 - 9 × 4 = 70

After interchanging the given two symbols + and × the equation is as follows : 15 × 5 ÷ 1 - 9 + 4 = 70

⇒ 15 × __**5 ÷ 1**__ - 9 + 4 = 70

⇒ __**15 × 5**__ - 9 + 4 = 70

⇒ __**75**__ - 9 __**+ 4**__ = 70

⇒ __**79 - 9**__ = 70

⇒ **70 = 70**

LHS = RHS

II. Given equation : 18 × 17 + 3 - 6 ÷ 2 = 133

After interchanging the given two symbols + and × the equation is as follows : 18 + 17 × 3 - 6 ÷ 2 = 133

⇒ 18 + 17 × 3 - __**6 ÷ 2**__ = 133

⇒ 18 + __**17 × 3**__ - 3 = 133

⇒ __**18 + 51**__ - 3 = 133

⇒ __**69 - 3**__ = 133

⇒ **66 ≠ 133**

**LHS ≠ RHS**

∴ Here, Conclusion II is not correct.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only II".**

• DPSPs are a set of guidelines for the government of India to follow in order to achieve social and economic justice for all citizens.
 
• They are enshrined in Part IV of the Constitution of India, and are not enforceable by the courts.
 
• However, they are fundamental to the governance of the country and the government is obliged to strive to implement them.

questions.question: The point on the surface, nearest to the focus of the earthquake, is called ______.

• **The focus, also known as the hypocenter, is the point within the Earth where an earthquake rupture starts.**
 
• The epicenter is the point on the surface directly above the focus.
 
• Seismic waves radiate in all directions from the focus, but they reach the epicenter first.
 
• This is why the epicenter is often the site of the most severe damage from an earthquake.

• **Hypocentre:-**

 
 
• Hypocentre of an earthquake is the point beneath the Earth's surface where the earthquake rupture begins.
 
• It is also known as the focus of the earthquake.
 
• The hypocentre is the source of the seismic waves that are generated by the earthquake.

• It is a sustainable and efficient system that can provide a variety of benefits, including:
 
 
• **Increased income and productivity**: Mixed farms can generate income from both crop and livestock sales, and the two enterprises can often complement each other. For example, the manure produced by livestock can be used to fertilize crops, and the crops can provide feed for the livestock.
 
• **Improved soil health: **Mixed farming can help to improve soil health by rotating crops and using manure to fertilize the land. This can lead to increased crop yields and reduced erosion.
 
• **Reduced risk**: Mixed farming can help to reduce risk by diversifying the farm's income streams. If one enterprise fails, the other can help to support the farm.
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• Subsistence farming is practiced all over the world, but it is particularly common in developing countries.
 
 
 
• **Shifting cultivation:-**
 
 
• **It is a type of agriculture in which plots of land are cultivated temporarily, then abandoned while post-disturbance fallow vegetation is allowed to freely grow while the cultivator moves on to another plot. **
 
• The period of cultivation is usually terminated when the soil shows signs of exhaustion or, more commonly, when the field is overrun by weeds.
 
• The period of time during which the field is cultivated is usually shorter than the period over which the land is allowed to regenerate by lying fallow.
